feature_sets.name: B_lms
feature_sets.description: Stronger non-twin LMS baseline. Adds broader behavioral and submission-discipline signals that a typical LMS analytics view could plausibly expose without any digital-twin engineering.

feature_sets.name: B_lms_plus_trends
feature_sets.description: LMS baseline plus short-horizon trend features. Tests whether recent direction of performance, activity, and attendance adds predictive value beyond cumulative LMS indicators.

feature_sets.name: B_lms_plus_mastery
feature_sets.description: LMS baseline plus current and overall mastery proxies. Tests whether topic-level Twin state adds value beyond raw performance and activity.

feature_sets.name: B_lms_plus_indices
feature_sets.description: LMS baseline plus composite engagement, performance, and discipline indices. Tests whether the current index layer adds compact value or mostly duplicates the underlying LMS signals.

feature_sets.name: B_lms_plus_temporal
feature_sets.description: LMS baseline plus the snapshot week number. Tests whether coarse course-time context explains gains separately from richer trend or mastery features.

feature_sets.name: B_lms_plus_trends_mastery
feature_sets.description: Compact Twin candidate combining the LMS baseline with trend and mastery blocks while excluding composite indices. Intended as a lean candidate for the later XAI phase if it is competitive with the full Twin set.

feature_sets.name: C_twin_full
feature_sets.description: Alias for the full Digital Twin representation used in ablation reports. Kept separate from `C_twin` naming so the baseline and ablation experiment pages can be cited cleanly.
